goal: Make inline conversational plans the default while preserving persisted specs for substantial work.

tasks.name: Add two-tier routing and planning
inputs: Existing contracts in spec-orchestrator, spec-brainstorm, and spec-plan
Approved Inline Plan and Spec-backed Plan terminology from CONTEXT.md
tasks.description: Make spec-orchestrator the sole automatic planning-mode classifier, with Inline Plan as the default only when explicitly selected by the orchestrator and direct spec-plan invocation defaulting to Spec-backed Plan. Restrict spec-brainstorm to the spec-backed route. Add explicit inline and spec-backed modes to spec-plan, preserving the existing plan.json schema and annotation cycle while making inline plans conversational, artifact-free, proportional, and subject to explicit approval.

tests: Review representative ordinary, substantial, ambiguous, and explicitly overridden requests against the routing rules
Verify the inline output against the approved five-section template
Verify the spec-backed path retains the existing plan.json contract
acceptance: Ordinary bounded work and ambiguous work route to Inline Plan by default
Concrete substantial-work signals route through spec-brainstorm
The selected mode and reason are visible and user-overridable
Inline mode creates no design.md, plan.json, Beads issues, or native todos and stops for approval
Spec-backed mode retains its existing artifacts and structured planning behavior

tasks.name: Keep persisted-spec execution and completion contracts
inputs: Existing spec-implement prerequisites, execution, reporting, and completion rules
Existing spec-finish validation and handoff rules
tasks.description: Keep spec-implement and spec-finish exclusive to approved Spec-backed Plans. Inline Plans are built directly by the main agent after approval and create no task tracking or execution workflow. Let spec-plan ask the human whether to switch to a Spec-backed Plan when inline planning reveals substantial needs. Permit spec-finish to make minor fixes and require blocking or scope-changing fixes to return to spec-implement.

tests: Verify an approved Inline Plan is built directly without invoking spec-implement or spec-finish
Trace an approved plan.json through the existing tracked-task path
Review material-scope-change and promotion handoffs for both routes
acceptance: Inline execution has no design.md, plan.json, tracker, subagent, or persisted-spec workflow prerequisite
Spec-backed implementation still loads dependencies and tracking from plan.json
Both modes require an approved written plan before implementation
Spec-backed Plans retain relevant tests, checks, diff review, and code review
Inline completion does not require Beads queries or report structured task counts

tasks.name: Constrain subagents to persisted-plan tasks
inputs: Approved Inline Plan and Spec-backed Plan execution contracts
Current subagent dispatch and two-stage review behavior
tasks.description: Reserve subagents for Spec-backed Plan tasks. Restore plan.json and design.md task context, retain focused dispatch and two-stage review, and prohibit implementer commits so the coordinator integrates and commits reviewed work serially.

tests: Populate the implementer and compliance-review templates with a plan.json task and design context
Verify implementers do not commit from a shared worktree
Review tracker-update guidance for Spec-backed Plans
acceptance: Prompt templates use plan.json task and design context
Inline Plans do not use subagents
Spec-backed subagents receive full task and design context
Compliance review checks design.md
The coordinator commits reviewed subagent work serially

tasks.name: Align repository and agent documentation
inputs: Final behavior from the planning and execution skills
Current workflow diagrams and skill descriptions in repository documentation
tasks.description: Document Inline Plan and Spec-backed Plan as the two canonical routes. Replace universal artifact and hard-transition claims with mode-aware guidance, make Beads and structured tracking conditional on the spec-backed route, and update Oracle and Architect checklists so persisted artifacts are required only for spec-backed work. Keep the approved domain language consistent across canonical sources.

tests: Compare workflow diagrams and routing descriptions across AGENTS.md and README.md
Review Oracle and Architect checklists under both planning modes
Search canonical guidance for stale universal artifact requirements
acceptance: Repository guidance and all workflow skills describe the same routing rules
Canonical diagrams show both Inline Plan and Spec-backed Plan paths
No canonical guidance says every project must produce design.md and plan.json
Oracle and Architect do not unconditionally create spec artifacts
Historical specs and independent worktrees remain unchanged

tasks.name: Validate the complete workflow
inputs: All modified workflow, agent, glossary, and documentation files
Success criteria from the approved design
tasks.description: Review the complete diff for contradictory routing, prerequisites, handoffs, and tracker requirements. Search canonical sources for stale universal-spec and artifact-only assumptions, run repository quality checks, and confirm the change did not modify application source, historical specs, or independent worktrees.

tests: Search canonical workflow sources for stale unconditional design.md, plan.json, and tracked-task requirements
acceptance: All repository quality checks pass
Inline and spec-backed examples follow their contracts end-to-end
No contradictory mode prerequisites or handoffs remain
The final diff is limited to approved workflow, guidance, glossary, agent, and planning-artifact files
